focus.name: player-interaction-family
focus.purpose: Promote Type-0x1A actor interaction and Type-0x7D/0x78/0x7A player interaction-proximity paths to behavior-based canonical names.

contracts.type1a: align receiver facing with PLAYER_WORLD_X when permitted, then publish PLAYER_INTERACTION_TYPE1A_LATCH or run the shared terminal-response sequence according to receiver phase
contracts.type7d: handle special-camera interaction animation and pending state, or arm PLAYER_TERMINAL_TRANSITION and invoke the proximity continuation
contracts.type78_7a: call Player_ProcessInteractionState when PLAYER_ACTION_RESPONSE_FIELD is clear or the actor lies within the encoded +/-8-pixel X window
